dates.title: Duke Undergraduate Admissions - Apply (deadlines, testing, recommendations, fees)

aid.title: Duke Undergraduate Financial Support - Awarding & Policy

test_policy.notes: Test-optional for first-year and transfer applicants in the 2026-2027 cycle; applies to international applicants too. No disadvantage for applying without scores.

requirements.notes: Three required recommendations: counselor plus two teachers. Alumni interviews are optional and prioritized by the admissions office (not all applicants are interviewed); international applicants may also use InitialView. CSS Profile required for need-based aid.

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding)
deadlines.notes: Decisions mid-December (no exact date published). Optional Glimpse interview due Nov 9.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decisions late March/early April (no exact date published). Optional Glimpse interview due Jan 11.

deadlines.label: Financial aid applications (ED)
deadlines.notes: CSS Profile and FAFSA listed with the ED application; additional documents such as tax forms due Nov 15.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Non-native English speakers or students not in an English-medium curriculum are recommended, not required, to take an English proficiency test. No preference among tests; highest score used.

english.notes: Minimum score expected: 100 on the internet-based TOEFL (also accepts Home Edition).
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency; minimum score expected: 180.

aid.notes: Duke admits U.S. citizens, permanent residents and a limited number of international students without regard to financial circumstance and meets 100% of each admitted student's demonstrated need; it expects to enroll 20 to 25 international students with full need met each year. All aid applicants submit the CSS Profile.

tier_notes.business: No undergraduate business major (Markets & Management certificate only).
tier_notes.nursing: No first-year BSN; Duke's nursing BSN is an accelerated second-degree program.
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Top-10 life sciences with a major medical center.
tier_notes.pre_med: Duke Health on campus gives top-5 research access and medical-school outcomes.
